up: Find activity measurements for a specific human protein target: 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 2A (CHEMBL224). Return assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for rows where the activity type is IC50 and pChEMBL value is present. Order the output by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT a.assay_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE ass.tid = 224
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.assay_id
LIMIT 1000;
